what_happened: Reading ~/.sapience/mcp.py (vendor MCP server source) directly surfaced exact auth mechanism (token= query param, not Bearer header) and the precise /ingest-kos KO object shape, letting the research ground the dispatch's already-measured live-host findings in concrete request/response shapes without any additional live-host probing.

context/project/sapience/domain/subagent-orientation.md currently argues at length against building a per-dispatch Sapience retrieval injection, calling it exactly the second always-on injection path the extension's anti-goal forbids. Task 496 builds precisely that mechanism by design (the batch's stated purpose is replacing the memory extension's substrate). The plan/implement phases must update or supersede that file's reasoning, not leave a self-contradiction in the extension's own design record.

Dispatch description says to resolve source_dir from <project-root>/.claude-extensions.json; that file has no top-level source_dir key (jq returns null). It is a per-extension key (.extensions.<name>.source_dir). Edit targets named were correct; only the lookup path needed correcting. Also: description calls 360/449/450/487 'four non-terminal records', but state.json now reports all five declared dependencies (incl. 488) as completed, so the edges are satisfied and impose no sequencing constraint.

The prior research report grounded every dispatch claim in exact file paths and line numbers (call site at orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh:349-355, consumer at 831-832, mcp.py api()/ingest-kos shapes), so the plan phase needed zero re-derivation of settled findings. Planning surfaced five additions the report did not have (test-suite fixture stub rename, set_aside as a second silent-loss shape, the hang-vs-failure timeout gap, printf '%b' backslash hazard, index-entries.json line_count staleness) rather than re-litigating what was already settled.

sapience-retrieve.sh and sapience-remember.sh cannot be standalone-invoked from the source store for their deeper behavioral checks (real curl request, --dry-run JSON shape, unroutable-host timing) because they source lib/common.sh relative to their own SCRIPT_DIR, which only exists in the deployed .claude/scripts/ tree (shared across all deployed scripts). Only argument-validation paths that return before the source line (missing args, unknown flags) and shellcheck are verifiable pre-deploy. Deeper invocation verification for Phase 1 and 2 is deferred to Phase 4's post-deploy checks, which is structurally necessary and not a plan defect.

While running verify-deploy.sh for Phase 3 verification, observed foreign, non-descendant processes in this shared repo: test-verify-deploy-gate-selection-crash-net.sh and nested verify-deploy.sh invocations against /tmp fixture directories (PPIDs 2416109/2421192, unrelated to this dispatch's own process tree). Checked specs/state.json: no other task shows status implementing besides this task 496, and this task's own .lock/holder.json matches this session_id. git status shows no uncommitted changes to agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh or any sapience file from another writer. Concluded this is unrelated test activity (possibly another concurrent /orchestrate task improving verify-deploy.sh's own gate-selection feature) with no observed file conflict against this task's declared scope; proceeding, but will re-check for conflicts before Phase 4/7's deploy-headless.sh (__WHOLE_TREE__) runs.

Phase 3's verification bullet 'bash .claude/scripts/verify-deploy.sh (the complete gate set) exits 0' cannot pass pre-deploy by design: gate 5 (manifest-driven category parity) correctly flags 'sapience: Missing scripts: scripts/sapience-remember.sh / scripts/sapience-retrieve.sh' because the manifest now declares them but Phase 4's redeploy has not yet run. Ran the full battery once (took approx 8.5 minutes of actual execution after earlier environment contention cleared): 8 of 42 checks failed -- gate5 (expected, pre-deploy, resolved by Phase 4's redeploy); gates 3/4/10 hit their 60s timeouts (doc-lint, task-reference-lint, state.json schema validation -- not independently confirmed as pre-existing vs transient load, not touched by this task's edits); gate 8 (run-all.sh) reported failing/undiscoverable suites without this task having touched any test file yet; gate 20 (eager-load budget) and gate 22 (shellcheck lint) and gate 24 (dead-command-recommendation lint) also failed, all on paths unrelated to this task's declared file_scope. Did not chase these down further (out of scope / scope creep risk); sync-manifest-scripts.sh --check (the phase's own achievable, in-scope verification) passes cleanly. Will re-run the full gate set after Phase 4's redeploy and again at Phase 7 to confirm gate5 clears and to assess whether the other failures are pre-existing baseline or task-introduced.

Phase 4's full live write/read round trip against app.spnc.ai succeeded exactly as the research/plan predicted: V2 (sapience-remember.sh, explicit:true) wrote hash aeea7c9425b7ffb2 with written=1; V3a (sapience-retrieve.sh, source=[repo:nvim]) found it; V3b (direct curl, source=[repo:bimodal]) returned an empty result set even though the vault holds 2163 objects overall, confirming the repo-tag filter is a hard pre-filter; V4 (a temporarily-patched local copy of the deployed script with explicit forced to false, reverted immediately after, diff-confirmed identical to the pre-edit backup) reproduced the server's {ok:true,written:0,gated:1} silent-loss shape and the script correctly exited 2 naming 'gated=1' rather than treating ok:true as success.

No delete API exists on this vault (three probed routes all 404).
